fields.label: FAQs (question followed by answer)
fields.current:
How do I make a favorite Pokémon chart by type and generation?
Choose a Pokémon for each intersection of type and generation. Then pick your favorites from each row and column, including an overall favorite.

Can I see how my favorite Pokémon compare to the average Pokémon?
Yes. Open the analytics page to see if your picks tend to include Pokémon of a certain type, color, shape, evolution stage, or base stat total.

Can I export a chart of my favorite Pokémon of each type?
Yes. Export the Full grid, or choose Summary for your type, generation, starter, legendary, gimmick, and overall favorites. Both save as PNGs.

Is it free? Do I need an app or an account?
Free, in the browser, no sign-up, no download. Your choices save in this browser. Clearing browser data can remove them, so export a PNG to keep your chart.

Can I use my favorites in the other my151 tools?
Yes. The Pokédex builder and gym leader maker can filter their Pokémon lists to your saved favorites in this browser.

How do I make a favorite Pokémon chart by type and generation?
Choose a Pokémon for each type and generation cell. Then pick your favorites from each row and column, including an overall favorite.

Can I export a chart of my favorite Pokémon of each type?
Yes. Export the Full grid, or choose Simplified for your type, generation, starter, legendary, gimmick, and overall favorites. Both save as PNGs.

Is it free? Do I need an app or an account?
Free, in the browser, no sign-up, no download. Your choices save in this browser. Clearing browser data can remove them, so export a PNG to keep your chart.

Can I choose alternate forms or shiny Pokémon?
The picker includes alternate forms, including regional forms and Mega Evolutions. It uses non-shiny pixel-art sprites. Available choices depend on the cell's type and generation.

Yes. The Pokédex builder and gym leader maker can filter their Pokémon lists to your saved favorites in this browser.

launchReview.title: Copy review — approved in chat
launchReview.text: The five copy fields above are approved. Metadata, FAQs, and localizations use this copy. Further changes can be sent through Notes.

launchReview.title: Safari, Firefox, and iOS sharing
launchReview.text: Chromium passes. Real Safari/Firefox rendering and physical iOS share/Save Image remain unverified. A Chromium phone viewport does not establish those results.

launchReview.title: Tools-dropdown icons
launchReview.text: Original Pokédex and Gym Leader icons need uniform strokes and square proportions. Picker will reuse its frozen-row/column grid icon. Review pictures when those mockups exist.

launchReview.title: Release checks
launchReview.text: The coordinator must check the combined build, remove preview review files, update the admin launch timestamp, and verify real telemetry/admin records after rollout. No release approval control appears here.

optionalReview.title: Height and weight charts
optionalReview.text: The five requested charts are implemented. Additional measurement charts are optional and need verified form-specific data. Recommend keeping them outside launch scope.

optionalReview.title: Sprite wishlist, including Pokopia
optionalReview.text: The wishlist contains the requested Pokopia characters. Selector additions need matching Gen 5-style sprites and visual review. No sprite choice is ready here.

optionalReview.title: Metadata and future work
optionalReview.text: Seven official Chinese form descriptors remain unsourced. Sneasler has a source disagreement. Backup/import/undo and favorites-to-Dex autofill remain future work.
